subsection.name: Usage Conditions

description: Monitor system accounts for organization defined atypical usage

subsection.name: Disable Accounts for High Risk Individuals

subsection.name: Mandatory Access Control
description: Enforce organization defined mandatory access control policy over the set of covered subjects and objects specified in the policy, and where the policy
Is uniformly enforced across the covered subjects and objects within the system
Specifies that a subject that has been granted access to information is constrained from doing any of the following
Passing the information to unauthorized subjects or objects
Granting its privileges to other subjects
Changing one or more security attributes (specified by the policy) on subjects, objects, the system, or system components
Choosing the security attributes and attribute values (specified by the policy) to be associated with newly created or modified objects
Changing the rules governing access control
Specifies that organization defined subjects may explicitly be granted organization defined privileges such that they are not limited by any defined subset (or all) of the above constraints

subsection.name: Discretionary Access Control
description: Enforce organization defined discretionary access control policy over the set of covered subjects and objects specified in the policy, and where the policy specifies that a subject that has been granted access to information can do one or more of the following
Pass the information to any other subjects or objects
Grant its privileges to other subjects
Change security attributes on subjects, objects, the system, or the system’s components
Choose the security attributes to be associated with newly created or revised objects
Change the rules governing access control

subsection.name: Security Relevant Information
description: Prevent access to organization defined security relevant information except during secure, non operable system states

subsection.name: Role Based Access Control
description: Enforce a role based access control policy over defined subjects and object and control access based upon organization defined roles and users authorized to assume such roles

subsection.name: Revocatiuon of Access Authorizations
description: Enforce the revocations of access authorizations resulting from changes to the security attributes of subjects and objects based on organization defined rules governing the timing of revocations of access authorizations

subsection.name: Controlled Release
description: Release information outside of the system only if
The receiving organization defined system or system component provide organization defined controls
Organization defined controls are used to validate the appropriateness of the information designated for release

subsection.name: Audited Override of Access Control Mechanisms

subsection.name: Restrict Access to Specific Information Types
description: Restrict access to data repositories containing organization defined information types

subsection.name: Assert and Enforce Application Access
description: Require applications to assert, as part of the installation process, the access needed to the following system applications and functions
Provide an enforcement mechanism to prevent unauthorized access
Approve access changes after initial installation of the application

subsection.name: Attribute Based Access Control
description: Enforce attribute based access control policy over defined subject and objects and control access based upon organization defined attributes to assume access permissions

subsection.name: Individual Access
description: Provide organization defined mechanisms to enable individuals to have access to the following elements of their personally identifiable information

subsection.name: Discretionary and Mandatory Access Control
description: Enforce organization defined mandatory access control policy over the set of covered subjects and objects specified in the policy
Enforce organization defined discretionary access control policy over the set of covered subjects and objects specified in the policy

subsection.name: Processing Domains

subsection.name: Dynamic Information Flow Control

subsection.name: Flow Control of Encrypted Information
description: Prevent encrypted information from bypassing organization defined information flow control mechanisms by decrypting the information, blocking the flow of the encrypted information, terminating communications sessions attempting to pass encrypted information, organization defined procedure or method

subsection.name: Embedded Data Types
description: Enforce organization defined limitations on embedding data types within other data types

subsection.name: Metadata
description: Enforce information flow control based on organization defined metadata

subsection.name: One Way Flow Mechanisms
description: Enforce one way information flows through hardware based flow control mechanisms

subsection.name: Detection of Unsanctioned Information

subsection.name: Domain Authentication

subsection.name: Validation of Metadata

subsection.name: Approved Solutions
description: Employ organization defined solutions in approved configurations to control the flow of organization defined information across security domains

subsection.name: Physical or Logical Separation of Information Flows
description: Separate information flows logically or physically using organization defined mechanisms and/or techniques to accomplish organization defined required separations by types of information

subsection.name: Access Only
description: Provide access from a single device to computing platforms, applications, or data residing in multiples different security domains, while preventing information flow between the different security domains

subsection.name: Modify Non Releasable Information
description: When transferring information between different security domains, modify non releasable information by implementing organization defined modification action

subsection.name: Internal Normalized Format
description: When transferring information between different security domains, parse incoming data into an internal normalized format and regenerate the data to be consistent with its intended specification

subsection.name: Data Sanitization
description: When transferring information between different security domains, sanitize data to minimize delivery of malicious content, command and control of malicious code, malicious code augmentation, and steganography encoded data, spillage of sensitive information in accordance with organization defined policy

subsection.name: Audit Filtering Actions
description: When transferring information between different security domains, record and audit content filtering actions and results for the information being filtered

subsection.name: Redundant/Independent Filtering Mechanisms
description: When transferring information between different security domains, implement content filtering solutions that provide redundant and independent filtering mechanisms for each data type

subsection.name: Linear Filter Pipelines

subsection.name: Filter Orchestration Engines

Content filtering mechanisms successfully complete execution without errors
Content filtering actions occur in the correct order and comply with organization defined policy

subsection.name: Filter Mechanisms Using Multiple Processes
description: When transferring information between different security domains, implement content filtering mechanisms using multiple processes

subsection.name: Failed Content Transfer Prevention
description: When transferring information between different security domains, prevent the transfer of failed content to the receiving domain

subsection.name: Process Requirements for Information Transfer

Does not filter message content
Validates filtering metadata
Ensures the content associated with the filtering metadata has successfully completed filtering
Transfers the content to the destination filter pipelines

Assign or remove privileges, if necessary, to correctly reflect organizational mission and business needs

subsection.name: Log Use of Privileged Functions

subsection.name: Additional Logon Information
